Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 18  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the director of Johnny Concho, Don McGuire, was older compared to Nunzio Malasomma at the time their respective films were released. This stemmed from comparing the directors’ ages at the time of their films instead of correctly comparing their birth years to determine who was "older" in general. A fundamental misunderstanding of the problem's requirements led to the wrong solution, as the task specifically asked for the director who is generally older based on birth year, not when the films were made.

Explanation: The Planner finalized the conclusion based on the directors' ages during the respective films’ release dates, which is irrelevant to the question asked. Nunzio Malasomma (born February 4, 1894) is generally older than Don McGuire (born February 28, 1919), regardless of the films' release years. This logical error in comparative reasoning resulted in an incorrect conclusion.
